name: live5-hosttools
description: Live bundle 5: a mutation-capable stage that may use host tools, then a readOnly stage.

Do not modify any file. List the exact names of every tool you can call, then state in one sentence whether any tool name starts with mcp__ other than mcp__workflow_artifact__workflow_artifact, and whether you have codemode or tool_search.
